Staked at 1.12x the cycle's seed. The 9/16 rung was missing from this file when 9/17 was sized, so the ladder still believed it was on cycle 1 rung 2 and rolled the earlier win forward instead of restarting the cycle. The extra 12% was real money at risk and is charged here rather than quietly dropped.

Priced at the fill actually taken, not the -250 the ladder assumed. This rung was placed before the alerter read live prices, so the published -250 was a placeholder nobody bet at; the real prices were -325, -300, -300 and a $55.32 payout on $36.33 (-191.3). The original placeholder is kept in publishedPrice/publishedStake.
